headline: Stock plunge sparks margin loan trouble? Overdraft delinquencies surge among youth and elderly
summary: Overdraft delinquency at five major South Korean banks stood at 0.22%, with 0.33% for those in their 20s and younger and 0.37% for those aged 60 and older. About 63% of semiconductor stock-backed loans are held by elderly borrowers.
why: Margin and stock-backed loans link household credit to equity prices, so share price falls can trigger forced sales and credit losses. Banks track these delinquencies as a signal of household financial stress.
